name: Performance & Diagnóstico
description: Latências de API, erros HTTP e rastreabilidade de requisições

widgets.title: Tempo de Resposta (Percentis p50, p90, p99)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT percentile(duration, 50, 90, 99) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'Order Platform API' AND transactionType = 'Web' TIMESERIES SINCE 1 hour ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'Order Platform API' AND http.statusCode >= '400' FACET http.statusCode, name SINCE 1 hour ago
SELECT timestamp, `error.type`, `error.message`, name FROM TransactionError WHERE appName = 'Order Platform API' SINCE 1 hour ago LIMIT 50
SELECT timestamp, trace.id, spanId, name, duration FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'Order Platform API' AND (error IS true OR duration > 1) SINCE 1 hour ago LIMIT 50
